title: Fangcun AI (@FangcunLeap) on X
excerpt: We’re Fangcun AI (方寸跃迁), China’s first lab dedicated to independent third-party evaluation & technique research on frontier AI safety. Today we’re publishing our evaluation of DeepSeek V4.1 Flash-1017, the first report in our long-term third-party safety evaluation and research program.
